name: mmmdata-glm-reference
scope: Condition-level contrast and effect maps, for every consumer, until braintwill's estimator exists. Single-trial betas are out of scope (GLMsingle TYPED).

nondefault_pipeline_settings: FreeSurfer 8.2.0 recon-all run outside fMRIPrep and passed in (--fs-subjects-dir)
input.upstream_transforms: Head-motion correction, distortion correction, coregistration and normalisation are applied as one composed interpolation. fMRIPrep applies no spatial smoothing, temporal filtering or confound regression.

estimation.calibrated_engine: nilearn FirstLevelModel, AR(1) prewhitening: for consumers that need calibrated z or t
estimation.hrf: SPM canonical, no temporal or dispersion derivative
estimation.signal_scaling: each voxel divided by its temporal mean (nilearn signal_scaling=0), so effects are in percent signal change
estimation.run_combination: precision-weighted fixed effects across runs; sessions pooled

spatial.mask: intersection of the selected runs' fMRIPrep brain masks, used both to fit each run and to pool them

temporal.drift: every fMRIPrep cosine* column (the high-pass basis fMRIPrep computes, ~128 s cutoff); nilearn adds no drift terms, so high_pass is inert
temporal.non_steady_state: every non_steady_state_outlier* column fMRIPrep wrote, as one-hot spike regressors; the time axis is not trimmed

departures_from_bakeoff_reference_cell.reason: first passes run on unsmoothed data (DECIDED 2026-09-23); smoothing becomes a declared consumer transform

not_pinned_here.software_versions: each fit's metadata records its own nilearn version
not_pinned_here.voxel_or_roi_selection: a consumer argument; the ROI-definition rule is deliberately undecided

reference.description: Six rigid-body motion parameters plus the first six aCompCor components (fMRIPrep's combined WM+CSF mask, in fMRIPrep's variance order); cosines and non-steady-state spikes ride along via config.
